City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
FEBRUARY 23, 2010
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS: Argudo, Holloway, Solis, Mendoza, Lujan
COMMISSIONERS: Argudo, Holloway, Solis, Mendoza, Lujan
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF ARBOR DAY PROCLAMATION
Proclamation Arbor Day
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT ("MCA-129") - AMENDING TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ESTABLISH ZONING AND LAND USE REGULATIONS OF MEDICAL MARIJUANA COOPERATIVES AND COLLECTIVES WITHIN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) hold a public hearing; 2) waive reading of Ordinance No. 10-898 and read by title only; and 3) introduce Ordinance No. 10-898, amending Chapters 10.36, 10.40 and 10.60 of Title 10 of the La Puente Municipal Code (Municipal Code Amendment No. 129) establishing zoning and land use regulations of Medical Marijuana Cooperatives or Collectives and adopt the Negative Declaration.
B-1 MCA 129 - MMCC Staff Report
B-1 MCA 129 - Ordinance Attachment A
B-1 MCA 129 - PC Resolution Attachment B
B-1 MCA 129 - ND Attachment C
B-1 MCA 129 - Attachment D
B-1 MCA 129 - White Paper Attachment D-1
B-1 MCA 129 - Newspaper Articles Attachment D-2
RECESS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF FEBRUARY 9, 2010.
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of February 9, 2010.
A-1 MIN 02-09-10 CC Reg
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1268 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2009-10
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 10-4853, approving Warrant Register No. 1268.
D-1 Warrant Register #1268
D-2
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION FOR A LOAN FROM THE CITY GENERAL FUND TO THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION CAPITAL PROJECTS FUND FOR ADMINISTRATIVE AND OTHER COSTS FOR REDEVELOPMENT PROJECTS
It is recommended that the Council adopt Resolution No. 10-4854 and approve the loan agreement.
D-2 City Repayment Agreement Loan to CDC - Report
D-2 City Repayment Agreement Loan to CDC - Attach A
D-2 City Repayment Agreement Loan to CDC - Attach B
D-3
APPROVAL OF A JOINT USE AGREEMENT WITH THE HACIENDA-LA PUENTE UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT FOR THE USE OF A PORTION OF THE NELSON ELEMENTARY SCHOOL PROPERTY IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE NATURE EDUCATION CENTER
It is recommended that the City Council approve the joint use agreement with the Hacienda-La Puente Unified School District and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on its behalf.
D-3 Joint Use Agreement Report w HLPUSD
D-3 Joint Use Agreement w HLPUSD - Attach A
D-3 Nature Center Joint Use Agreement w HLPUSD- Att B
D-4
APPROVAL OF A JOINT USE AGREEMENT WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT FOR THE USE OF A MAINTENANCE ROAD IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE NATURE EDUCATION CENTER
It is recommended that the City Council approve the joint use agreement with the Los Angeles Flood Control District and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on its behalf.
D-4 Joint Use Agreement Report w LA Co Flood Control
D-4 Joint Use Agreement w LA County - Attach A
D-5
APPROVAL OF A RESOLUTION ACKNOWLEDGING THAT THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION WILL BORROW $176,924 FROM THE COMMISSION'S LOW MODERATE INCOME HOUSING FUND TO PAY THE STATE-MANDATED SUPPLEMENTAL EDUCATIONAL REVENUE AUGMENTATION FUND
It is recommended that the City Council consider and adopt Resolution No. 10-4855, acknowledging that the La Puente Community Development Commission will borrow $176,924 from the CDC's Low Moderate Income Housing fund to pay the State-mandated Supplemental Educational Revenue Augmentation Fund and Authorizing the City Manager to so inform the County Auditor.
D-5 City SERAF Notice Payment Rpt
D-5 City SERAF Notice Payment - Attach A
D-6
APPROVAL OF SUPPORT FOR HACIENDA- LA PUENTE UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT READINESS AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT GRANT APPLICATION AND PARTNER CERTIFICATION
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Mayor to execute the letter of support for the Hacienda-La Puente Unified School District (HLPUSD) Readiness and Emergency Management for Schools (REMS) grant and the Partner Certification.
D-6 Letter of Support for HLPUSD grant application
D-6 HLPUSD Partner Certification- Att A
D-6 HLPUSD Letter of Support- Att B
D-7
APPROVAL OF STATE PROGRAM SUPPLEMENT AGREEMENT NO.009-N FOR THE LEFT TURN SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS AT TEMPLE AVENUE AND SUNSET AVENUE, TEMPLE AVENUE AND ORANGE AVENUE, AND VALLEY BOULEVARD AND FERRERO LANE
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) adopt Resolution No. 10-4856 approving Administering Agency - Program Supplement Agreement No.009-N for the Left Turn Signal Improvements; and 2) authorize the City Manager or her designee to execute the Administering Agency - Program Supplement Agreement on behalf the City.
D-7 Left Turn Signal Improvements Report
D-7 Left Turn Signal Improvements Attach A
D-7 Left Turn Signal Improvements Attach B
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
RECESS
RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL
AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS/ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM CITY MANAGER
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
F-2
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION – SIGNIFICANT EXPOSURE TO LITIGATION PURSUANT TO SUBDIVISION (b) OF SECTION 54956.9: LETTER DATED JANUARY 14, 2009 FROM LOS ANGELES COUNTY COUNCIL THREATENING TO JOIN CITY AS DEFENDANT IN NATURAL RESOURCES DEFENSE COUNCIL, INC. ET AL. VS. COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES ET AL., NO. 08-1467 AHM UNLESS A TOLLING AGREEMENT IS SIGNED
F-3
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(a) TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL TO DETERMINE WHETHER TO INTERVENE IN EXISTING LITIGATION A False Claims Action filed under seal in Los Angeles Superior Court No. BC 410135 and ordered to be confidential pursuant to Government Code section 12652(c)
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
February 23, 2010
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on February 23, 2010, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Members Present:
Argudo, Holloway, Solis, and Mendoza.
Staff Members present:
City Manager Kenline, Assistant City Manager Yamachika, Commission Counsel Casso, City Clerk Turner, Public Works Director Salas, Finance Director Kim, Recreation Services Director Bistarkey, City Planner Arreola, Management Analyst Ortega, Community Preservation Supervisor Blakely, Senior Management Assistant Giron, Rehabilitation Grant Specialist Galvan, Accounting Assistant Newcomb, and Records Technician Garcia.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF ARBOR DAY PROCLAMATION
Proclamation Arbor Day
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT ("MCA-129") - AMENDING TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ESTABLISH ZONING AND LAND USE REGULATIONS OF MEDICAL MARIJUANA COOPERATIVES AND COLLECTIVES WITHIN THE CITY
B-1 MCA 129 - MMCC Staff Report
B-1 MCA 129 - Ordinance Attachment A
B-1 MCA 129 - PC Resolution Attachment B
B-1 MCA 129 - ND Attachment C
B-1 MCA 129 - Attachment D
B-1 MCA 129 - White Paper Attachment D-1
B-1 MCA 129 - Newspaper Articles Attachment D-2
Holloway moved to direct staff to draft an Ordinance setting the number of Medical Marijuana Collectives and Cooperatives to zero, increase the sensitive use area to 1000 feet, include churches as a sensitive use, and provide Council with a timeline and plan of action to phase out Medical Marijuana Collectives and Cooperatives.; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Mendoza, Solis, Holloway, and Argudo. NOES: None.
RECESS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS

READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF FEBRUARY 9, 2010.
A-1 MIN 02-09-10 CC Reg
Holloway moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of February 9, 2010 with the correction that Mayor Lujan was absent ; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Mendoza, Solis, Holloway, and Argudo. NOES: None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
